title: Case 0003 — DRR (same scan as the CT tab)

surgery.primary: anterior/interbody fusion — single- or two-level ALIF (≈6°, best at L5–S1) ± LLIF
surgery.rationale: Correction need ΔLL = (PI−LL−9) + (PT−20) = 4.0° (Eq. 73.1); |PI−LL| 9.8°, PT 23.2° → mild deformity (Table 73.3). Matched to the least-invasive technique whose Table 73.2 lordosis ceiling covers 4.0°.

summary.note: Corners predicted by the network on this synthetic radiograph; angles measured from those corners by ostk.metrics2d. The femoral head is a 3-D fit and is not predicted.

landmarks.label: Bicoxofemoral axis (femoral head centre)
landmarks.desc: Midpoint of the two femoral head centres (Legaye & Duval-Beaupère 1998). On a lateral film the two heads superimpose, so this is a single point. PI and PT are undefined without it — which is why a coned lumbar lateral yields only SS and LL.

truth_corners.note: Endplate corners fitted in the volume and projected, with the body carved at the anterior wall of the canal. Shipped for comparison, not as the measured line: on this case they agree with the network to about 3 mm anteriorly and 5 mm posteriorly across L1-L5, and disagree by 13 mm at S1, where the sacral canal is not the same landmark and this carve does not transfer.
